posts.caption:
Pick an element. Outplay your friends. ⚔️

Element Arena is in open beta: real-time creature battles you can play free right now, in your browser on phone, tablet or computer. 18 original creatures, 9 elements, live duels, team fights and raid bosses.

This is the first taste. The iPhone and Android apps come later, with more champions, skins and features. Play now and help shape them: found a bug? In the game, tap the gear, then Report a problem.

Link in bio.

#ElementArena #indiegame #mobilegame #pvp #browsergame

Dodge. Dash. Land the big one. ⚡

Every duel is live: aim your skills, read your rival and time your ultimate. No turns, no waiting.

Open beta, free in your browser. Tip: add it to your home screen and it plays fullscreen, like an app. Our "Play it like an app" post shows how. Link in bio.

#ElementArena #pvp #indiegame #mobilegame #gamedev

Play it like an app. 📲

Put Element Arena on your home screen in 30 seconds: it opens fullscreen, with no browser bars and nothing to download. Swipe for the steps, from a real iPhone.

iPhone, in Safari:
1. Open play.elementarenausa.com (link in bio)
2. Tap the button at the left end of the address bar, then Share
3. Tap View More, then Add to Home Screen
4. Keep "Open as Web App" on, and tap Add
No button there? Tap Share at the bottom of Safari, then Add to Home Screen.

Android, in Chrome:
1. Open play.elementarenausa.com
2. Tap ⋮ at the top right
3. Tap Install app (or Add to Home screen), then Install

Then tap the icon, turn your phone sideways and play. 🎮

It's an open beta, a first taste before the iPhone and Android apps. Found a bug? In the game, tap the gear, then Report a problem.

Save this for later, and send it to the friend who always asks how. 👇

#ElementArena #indiegame #mobilegame #browsergame #gamingtips

18 creatures. 9 elements. 🔥💧⚡🌿

Fire, Water, Electric, Nature, Earth, Light, Shadow, Psychic and Aura, two champions each, every one with its own kit. More are on the way for the iPhone and Android apps.

Who are you picking first? Tell us in the comments 👇

#ElementArena #indiegame #mobilegame #characterdesign #pvp

Seven bosses, seven puzzles. 🏮

Meet Lumiwick, a lantern with a temper. Every raid boss has one trick to learn: solve it solo or bring up to three friends.

Start with Cragmuff: one clear opens the other six. Open beta, free in your browser, link in bio.

#ElementArena #raidboss #indiegame #mobilegame #coop

Hang out between fights. 🎪

The Plaza is Element Arena's shared playground, up to 40 players at once: bounce pads, a ball pitch, a dash track, a stage, a photo spot, gifts and daily quests. Every 15 minutes there's an Orb Shower: grab as many orbs as you can around the fountain.

Open beta, free in your browser. Link in bio.

#ElementArena #indiegame #mobilegame #browsergame #gamedev

Found a bug? Tell us. 🐞

Element Arena is in open beta, so things still break, and every report helps us fix them before the iPhone and Android apps.

In the game: tap the gear at the top, then Report a problem (it needs a free account). Or tell us in the comments here. Say what you were doing and what went wrong. Every report gets read.

#ElementArena #indiegame #gamedev #indiedev #betatest

Bring your friends. 👯

Share your friend code, invite them to your room, jump into theirs, or watch their match live, all from the Lobby. Then team up in 2v2, or settle it in a duel.

Open beta, free in your browser on phone, tablet or computer. Tag the friend you're bringing. 👇

#ElementArena #indiegame #mobilegame #pvp #browsergame

Better with a friend. 🤝

Team up in 2v2, stack your skills and wipe the other side. Tag the friend you'd queue with.

Open beta, free in your browser, link in bio.

#ElementArena #pvp #indiegame #mobilegame #multiplayer

Champion spotlight: Pyranda 🔥

A shy red panda with a flame at the tip of its tail. Lobs burning chestnuts from the back line.

🌰 Chestnut Mortar: a burning chestnut over walls
🔥 Hot Coals: a patch that burns anyone in it
🧱 Ember Curtain: a wall of embers that burns up enemy shots
💥 Chestnut Storm (ultimate): five blasts march across the arena

Who should we spotlight next?

#ElementArena #indiegame #mobilegame #characterdesign #pvp

Walk in a legend. ✨

Ashen Warlord, Abyssal Reaver, Hellforge: Mythical skins with their own entrance, victory and ultimate. Win in them to awaken them, stage by stage. Try anything on before you spend a coin. More skins are coming with the iPhone and Android apps.

All cosmetic, never stronger.

Everyone against everyone in the Ember Forge. Watch your back.
